script.title: Why Indian Companies Raised ₹84,400 Cr in IPOs #shorts

segments.text: Indian companies just raised ₹84,400 crore from IPOs in six months.
segments.broll: hands counting Indian rupee notes close up

segments.text: That is a massive 30% jump compared to last year.
Promoters and VCs are using this market boom to exit and cash out.
They know retail investors are hungry for high-profile new listings.
broll_alt: young person looking at smartphone screen

segments.text: So companies are fixing smaller offer sizes to create artificial demand.
Before buying any IPO hype, always analyze business cash flows, not just listing gains.
broll_alt: coffee cup next to financial report

segments.text: Not financial advice, but when retail FOMO peaks, that is exactly why...
